actions.name: createGrid

useWhen: Use this action when you need to create inferred horizontal and/or vertical Cartesian grid lines behind related marks, or infer the Polar grid families backed by stored theta/radius encodings.
avoidWhen: Avoid this action when an existing owned resource should be revised, or when required inputs leave multiple compatible sources unnamed.
requiredState: The compatible encoding, scale, coordinate, mark, or guide owner required by this component must already be stored unambiguously.

semantic: Creates inferred horizontal and/or vertical Cartesian grid lines behind related marks, or infer the Polar grid families backed by stored theta/radius encodings. The changed semantic owner or assignment is structurally copied into the returned program.
graphic: Materializes or rematerializes the affected backend-neutral graphical subtree when the required semantic state is complete.
